feedback_comment: It was a helpful estimate that made the cognitive effort lower and the task easier and faster.
I didn't recognize some of the food (just a few).

I have a hard time estimating how much each food item is generally worth calorically. I have no way of telling if seasoning, sweetening, sauce, etc. was used easily. It was hard for me, even when I did have a rough idea of have caloric a food should be, to scale that amount based on the portion size. The portion not being in a uniform shape also made the judgement more difficult.
Did not have a mental estimate of how many calories come from each ingredient (I hardly control diet :-()
The AI estimates seemed quite reasonable and I trusted the values it gave.

I had no way of telling if the AI gram estimate was accurate so I just blindly trusted it. Since it was hard for me to determine what the calorie count would be on my own I found myself blindly trusting the AI's output since I couldn't guess any better and the estimates it gave seemed to make sense to me. It rarely changed the calorie count from the suggestion but when I did I was fairly  sure the number didn't seem right.
